result.title: Scale-Invariant Empirical-Bayes Laplace Approximation for ReLU Networks
result.summary: ReLU networks are well-known to have continuous scale symmetries; infinitely many reparameterized weight vectors that represent the same function. Dinh et al. (2017) have shown that, by reparameterizing, the geometry of the loss landscape (e.g., curvature) of these networks can be changed arbitrarily without affecting the underlying function. Thus, any quantity that depends on the network's geometry should be defined with care. In this paper, we show that the Empirical Bayes (EB) Laplace's approximation is not well-defined for ReLU networks, mainly due to Hessian dependence in computing the marginal likelihood, which is not invariant under ReLU scale symmetries. Thus, we can get different prior precisions, posterior covariances, and predictive uncertainties for a network having identical predictions under ReLU scaling. We define family of prior precision fields indexed by $γ$ and introduce $γ$-canonicalization, which first converts the network to its canonical representation by balancing the ratio of incoming to outgoing weights, and then fits the Empirical Bayes (EB) Laplace to the canonical representation. This procedure is equivalent to transporting the isotropic Gaussian prior from the canonical representation to the original coordinates, by producing a ReLU-scale-compatible precision field. This makes the marginal likelihood invariant under ReLU scaling, while allowing $γ$ to be selected by maximizing the marginal likelihood. The resulting EB Laplace approximation is well-defined on ReLU scale-equivalence classes and yields consistent prior precision selection and predictive uncertainties across functionally identical parameterizations.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出 Empirical Bayes Laplace 近似在 ReLU 网络尺度对称性下不良定义，因为边际似然依赖 Hessian 而不具尺度不变性；提出以 γ 参数化的先验精度场与「γ-规范化」（平衡出入权重比）后再做 EB Laplace，使边际似然在尺度等价类上不变，从而稳定选出先验精度与预测不确定性。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作着眼参数化对称下的几何量与不确定性度量是否良定义，与 LVR 中对 latent 表示几何、相似度及不确定性/证据度量受位置、深度与参数化影响的关注可能相通，可核查其不变性构造能否用于 latent 状态比较与置信度评估。
